                                             [Code Civ. Proc. § 2031.010 et seq.]

PROPOUNDING PARTY: Plaintiff MERIDIAN LOGISTICS, INC.
RESPONDING PARTY:  Defendant FALLBROOK FREIGHT SYSTEMS, LLC
SET NO.:           ONE

Plaintiff Meridian Logistics, Inc. demands, under Code of Civil Procedure section 2031.010, that Defendant Fallbrook Freight Systems, LLC produce and permit the inspection and copying of the documents described below, at the offices of Brightwater & Osei LLP, 77 Commerce Street, Suite 1400, San Francisco, California 94104, within thirty (30) days after service of this demand.

DEFINITIONS

1. "YOU" and "YOUR" mean Defendant Fallbrook Freight Systems, LLC and its officers, directors, employees, and agents.
2. "DOCUMENT" has the meaning given in Evidence Code section 250 and includes electronically stored information.
3. "THE AGREEMENT" means the Master Transportation Services Agreement dated June 3, 2023.

INSTRUCTIONS

A. Produce the documents as they are kept in the usual course of business, or organized and labeled to correspond with the categories below, under Code of Civil Procedure section 2031.280(a).
B. Produce electronically stored information in the form in which it is ordinarily maintained or in a reasonably usable form.
C. If YOU withhold any DOCUMENT on a claim of privilege or attorney work product, serve a privilege log identifying the document, its date, its author, its recipients, and the basis of the claim, sufficient to permit an evaluation of the claim under Code of Civil Procedure section 2031.240(c).
D. This demand is continuing. If YOU obtain a responsive DOCUMENT after responding, supplement YOUR response.
E. YOUR written response is due within thirty (30) days after service, extended as Code of Civil Procedure section 1010.6 provides for electronic service. Failure to respond waives objections, including privilege, under section 2031.300.

DEMAND FOR INSPECTION

DEMAND NO. 1: All DOCUMENTS constituting or evidencing THE AGREEMENT, including every amendment, exhibit, and schedule.

DEMAND NO. 2: All DOCUMENTS concerning YOUR capacity to perform under THE AGREEMENT between January 1, 2025 and June 30, 2025.

DEMAND NO. 3: All communications between YOU and Plaintiff concerning any shipment tendered under THE AGREEMENT in March 2025.
